# BACTEREMIA ASSOCIATED WITH ENTEROCOCCI

Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases.
Treatment of susceptible enterococcus (Van A/B negative on BCID Biofire)
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]
Treatment of resistant enterococcus (Van A/B positive on BCID Biofire)
Linezolid 600 mg IV q12h ($$$$) [DI]

# Duration of treatment

For uncomplicated infections where blood cultures are sterile after 24 hours of treatment, treat for 7-14 days. A longer duration is needed if infection is complicated or repeat blood cultures are positive.

Therapy:
## Enterococcus faecalis is almost always susceptible to penicillins locally, ampicillin is preferred over vancomycin in susceptible isolates.
Enterococcus faecium is typically resistant to some beta-lactams, aminoglycosides, and vancomycin.
Refer to cardiovascular section for suspected infectious endocarditis.
